تبتدهي (form VIII)
# تَبْتَدِهِي (tabtadihī) /tab.ta.di.hiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# تُبْتَدَهِي (tubtadahī) /tub.ta.da.hiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
